newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates end firmer, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates end firmer, seen stable.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates closed firmer on Wednesday as market liquidity tightened slightly on routine monthly payroll demand, but dealers expected the rates to stabilise around current levels.

The overnight interbank rate closed at 4.987 against Tuesday's 4.951, with 30-day commercial paper at 5.25-5.30 against 5.25. Dealers noted that T$9.3 billion of treasury bills would mature on Thursday, easing current tight liquidity triggered by the payroll call.
The bond market was quiet in the afternon. Traders expected bond yields to move slightly upward. - Julie Hu (508-0815)
